title: Add RAG Replayer-Lite walkthrough with step assertions and API-proxy shim
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a lightweight RAG replayer quickstart with step-level assertions, an optional API-proxy shim for deterministic local replay, and telemetry hooks for Redwood Console.
description: Context: teams building RAG features regularly need to reproduce session-level behavior for debugging and regression testing. This PR introduces a small, local-first 'RAG Replayer-Lite' quickstart that captures and replays a single session and lets developers assert expected step outputs and instrument telemetry. Motivation: heavier session recorders are powerful but cumbersome for onboarding and CI; the replayer-lite focuses on developer turnaround: small footprint, single-command run, and deterministic proxying. What this PR adds: 1) quickstarts/rag-replayer-lite/README.md - walkthrough and API; 2) replayer runner (quickstarts/rag-replayer-lite/runner.sh) that spins up a local proxy and runs a recorded session; 3) simple WebProxy shim (quickstarts/rag-replayer-lite/proxy.js) that can stub upstream model responses for deterministic replay or route to Redwood hosted endpoints; 4) examples/sample-session.json - captured events with step IDs and annotations for assertions; 5) tests/jest/replayer-lite.test.ts - example assertions that can be used in CI; 6) docs/snippets/replayer-lite.md - docs site snippet and embedding instructions; 7) package.json and minimal dev deps to keep it lightweight. How it works: the runner launches the proxy which serves two modes: replay-mode (returns recorded tokens/outputs for each step) and pass-through mode (for live debugging). The sample-session.json maps request fingerprints to a sequence of events (input chunk, tool calls, model token blocks) so the runner asserts step boundaries and expected outputs. Checklist: - [x] Add README and quickstart guide - [x] Add proxy shim and runner script - [x] Add sample session and step assertions - [x] Add unit test demonstrating CI-friendly assertions - [x] Update docs snippets for docs.redwood.ai - [x] Manual smoke run against local runner and with Redwood hosted test key Testing: run scripts/run-replayer.sh --mode=local to exercise replay-mode; CI runs jest with the included sample test to ensure deterministic passing. Security & privacy: sample session redacts all PII and includes a short note in README on how to sanitize real recordings before adding to the repo. Rollout/Docs: this quickstart is intended for the quickstarts collection (non-production tooling) and documented under "Debugging & Replay" in the quickstarts index. Related: pairs with ENG-1423 (replay infra spike) and references internal RFC-RAG-REPLAY-2025. Notes for maintainers: keep the dependency surface minimal; prefer in-repo JS/TS for portability. Migration: none required for existing quickstarts.
